faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.intro: Below you will find answers to the most common questions about your rental contract, service and warranties. Can't find your question? Feel free to contact us.

q1.question: Can I cancel early?
q1.answer: Cancelling during the ongoing rental term is generally not possible; a fixed contract period applies. [TE BEVESTIGEN] The exact notice period and conditions are stated in your rental agreement and may differ per contract. Contact us so we can review your specific situation.

q2.question: What happens after the rental term?
q2.answer: When your rental term ends you have three options: you can buy the installation at its residual value, extend the rental, or have the panels removed free of charge. We contact you well before your contract ends to go through the options. Unsure which choice suits you? Contact us.

q3.question: How do I submit a service request?
q3.answer: You submit a service request easily through our contact form; select the "Service request" category. Describe as clearly as possible what you have noticed, so we can help you faster. We respond within 2 business days. Do you have an urgent fault? Please mention this in your message via the contact form.

q4.question: Which warranties apply?
q4.answer: Several warranties apply to your installation, including the manufacturer's warranty on the panels and the inverter. [TE BEVESTIGEN] The exact warranty periods and coverage differ per component and per contract. The conditions that apply to you are set out in your agreement; when in doubt, contact us about your specific situation.

q5.question: How long will my system last?
q5.answer: Solar panels last 25 to 30 years on average and usually keep generating power afterwards, albeit at a gradually declining yield. The inverter typically has a shorter lifespan and may be replaced once during the term. We continuously monitor the performance of your installation. Questions about the condition of your system? Contact us.

q6.question: What happens if I sell my house?
q6.answer: When you sell your home the rental contract can in most cases be transferred to the new owner, so the installation can simply stay in place. We guide you and the buyer through this contract transfer. Let us know in good time once a sale is on the horizon, and we will arrange the transfer smoothly. Contact us to start the transfer.
